title: Generative Retrieval for Reverse Target Fishing with a Proteome-Scale Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.24458v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reverse target fishing identifies protein targets for a query molecule and is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Discriminative approaches adapted from virtual screening face sparse, long-tailed associations and missing-not-at-random measurements: treating unrecorded pairs as negatives can suppress genuine targets. We reformulate the task as generative retrieval and introduce GenFish. Residual vector quantization converts frozen protein language model features into shared semantic identifiers. Given a molecular fingerprint, GenFish autoregressively models codes conditioned on the query and preceding code, ranking proteins by identifier likelihood without explicitly labeling unrecorded pairs as negatives. We introduce ProTargetBench, the first proteome-scale benchmark for reverse target fishing to jointly support measured-panel discrimination and full-catalogue recovery of experimentally recorded positives. translated_title: 基于蛋白质组规模基准的反向靶标垂钓生成式检索
translated_abstract: 反向靶标垂钓为查询分子识别蛋白靶标，是药物发现与药物重定位的核心任务。从虚拟筛选改编而来的判别式方法面临稀疏、长尾的关联以及非随机缺失的测量问题：将未记录的蛋白-分子配对视为负样本可能会抑制真实的靶标。我们将该任务重新表述为生成式检索，并提出了GenFish。通过残差向量量化，将冻结的蛋白质语言模型特征转换为共享的语义标识符。给定分子指纹后，GenFish以查询和前序编码为条件自回归地对编码进行建模，依据标识符似然对蛋白质进行排序，而无需将未记录的配对显式标记为负样本。我们同时提出了ProTargetBench，这是首个面向反向靶标垂钓的蛋白质组规模基准，可联合支持测量面板判别以及对实验记录阳性样本的全目录恢复。该基准覆盖20,431个Uni...（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GenFish，将反向靶标垂钓重新表述为生成式检索任务，通过残差向量量化蛋白质语言模型特征生成语义标识符，避免将未记录配对误判为负样本，并发布了首个蛋白质组规模基准ProTargetBench。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GenFish, which reformulates reverse target fishing as generative retrieval by converting protein language model features into semantic identifiers via residual vector quantization, and introduces ProTargetBench, the first proteome-scale benchmark for this task.
